analyst_view.overall: Early view: Leverkusen lost their unbeaten league-phase record with a 1-0 home defeat to Marseille, and Besiktas, under Vincenzo Italiano, lost 3-2 at Celtic after leading twice. The sides are close in the table (7th and 8th), so both have something to play for in the race for the top eight.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. Leverkusen were blunt against Marseille with ten shots and no goal, but Besiktas' 3-2 at Celtic shows their games can open up, so the two pull in opposite directions.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners. Leverkusen won six corners against Marseille with 58 percent possession, and Besiktas earned seven at Celtic, so nothing points away from the site's figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards. Besiktas picked up two late bookings at Celtic, and the referee for this game is not known yet, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.1 shots. I lean slightly lower: Leverkusen's game against Marseille produced only 18 shots in total, and they tend to keep the ball rather than shoot often.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target. Besiktas put four of 15 on target at Celtic; with no team news yet I see no clear reason to move.
